_about: Gated detail for approved NDA viewers (PLAN.md §4.9). Written by Claude from the private build pack; Chris reviews it, then sets "reviewed": true. tools/gated_sql.py refuses to load a file until then. 'notes' are for Chris only and never reach the database or the site.

P-POR-01.summary: A community safety network: a network of verified safe-haven locations, with partner businesses in the community and fast help when it's needed.

sections.heading: Planned features
items: A network of verified safe-haven locations
A panic alert with emergency escalation to 000

P-POR-02.summary: The PORTUS app: a silent alert, live location for trusted contacts and the way to the nearest safe haven, on the phone they already carry.

sections.heading: Planned features
items: Live location shared with trusted contacts
A map to the nearest safe haven
Discreet mode for people at risk: quick exit, no history

P-POR-03.summary: PORTUS for children: a big, simple SOS button, child-safe places to go and parents or carers alerted straight away.
